notes.value: BYD Atto 2 Premium, per the Mega Motor spec flyer (Jan 2026) and the BYD Pakistan brochure (Aug 2026): 45.12 kWh Blade LFP, 130 kW / 290 Nm front motor, 7.9 s 0–100, 380 km NEDC, 82 kW DC (CCS2) and 7 kW AC (Type 2), V2L. 4310×1830×1675 mm, wheelbase 2620 mm, boot 380 L (1,320 L seats folded), kerb 1,550 kg, six airbags, 12.8-inch rotating screen. BYD Pakistan quotes a 30–80% DC charge in 30 minutes; the 38 minutes stored is the 10–80% figure reported at launch. Top speed and ground clearance are not published officially. PKR 7,290,000 with a booking of about 1,400,000. Mega Motor Company.

notes.value: BYD Atto 3 Advanced, per the BYD Pakistan brochure (Aug 2026) and byd-mega.com: 49.92 kWh Blade LFP, 150 kW / 310 Nm front motor, 7.9 s 0–100, 410 km NEDC (about 480 km is published elsewhere on WLTP; the two cycles are not a span). DC charging up to 88 kW, 30–80% in 29 minutes; AC about 7 kW. Seven airbags and a 15.6-inch rotating touchscreen. 4455×1875×1615 mm, wheelbase 2720 mm, 1,340 L luggage with seats folded. Top speed, kerb weight and ground clearance are not in official material. PKR 8,990,000. Mega Motor Company. The trim is carried in the model name rather than the variant field.

notes.value: BYD Seal Dynamic: 61.44 kWh Blade LFP, single 150 kW / 310 Nm rear motor, 7.5 s 0–100, 510 km NEDC, 110 kW DC (CCS2) and 7 kW AC (Type 2). Pakistan also sells the Seal Premium (82.56 kWh, 230 kW, 5.9 s, 650 km NEDC, 150 kW DC) at Rs 16.99 million, which is not this row. Trim figures come from a BYD spec table hosted by PakWheels whose trim names and dimensions match the BYD Pakistan (Mega Motor) brochure. Top speed and ground clearance are not published officially.

notes.value: Range 567 km on the NEDC cycle, per the BYD Pakistan brochure (Aug 2026); WLTP for comparable trims elsewhere is about 482 km, and no factor converts between cycles. The brochure lists 9 airbags and confirms 82.56 kWh, 230 kW, 380 Nm and 6.7 s. BYD Pakistan quotes a 30–80% DC charge within 30 minutes but no kW rating; the 150 kW stored is the international figure for this battery and motor. Ex-factory price is PKR 15,490,000 exactly; the headline figure is rounded to 1.55 Cr.
